items.ncert_ref: Figure it Out Q3 (book p.11, printed answer p.25-26; ref FiO1.q3)
items.question_text: For each statement below, determine whether it is always true, sometimes true, or never true. Explain your answer, with examples and non-examples, and justify your claim using algebra. (i) The sum of two even numbers is a multiple of 3. (ii) If a number is not divisible by 18, then it is also not divisible by 9. (iii) If two numbers are not divisible by 6, then their sum is not divisible by 6. (iv) The sum of a multiple of 6 and a multiple of 9 is a multiple of 3. (v) The sum of a multiple of 6 and a multiple of 3 is a multiple of 9.
items.reason: Per statement a counter-example or an algebraic line (6a + 9b = 3(2a + 3b), 6a + 3b = 3(2a + b)) and a verdict; all text, and the printed answer (book p.25-26) is text too.
